bug_report:
Procedures are mishandled in -fc-prototypes-external
Original test case by Jürgen Bausa.

The following cases are mishandled with -fc-prototypes-external:

      SUBROUTINE FCN (JAC)
      EXTERNAL JAC
      INTEGER JAC
      PRINT *,JAC(52)
      END

gives

void fcn_ (int *jac);

and

      SUBROUTINE BAR(JAC)
      EXTERNAL JAC
      CALL JAC(42)
      END

gives an error:

bar.f:1:22:

    1 |       SUBROUTINE BAR(JAC)
      |                      1~~
Error: Cannot convert 'UNKNOWN' to interoperable type at (1)
